mentions.name: Chatpak
mentions.description: This web service turns group chats into printed photobooks: it generates automatic layouts with no editor or app required, offers unlimited free previews, and builds hardcovers of up to 1000 images that ship in minutes.
mentions.problem: Creating a physical souvenir for a long-running group chat meant spending hours curating photos in editors.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://chatpak.store/

Group chat photobooks. Automatic layouts, no editor/app, unlimited free previews. Build a hardcover (up to 1000 image) and ship it in minutes.

Wanted a physical souvenir for everyone in my long running signal chat but didn’t want to spend hours curating in editors.
